name: Brianna
source: An employee at Sunny Shine Funland. Brianna dresses up as Princess Lalabelle, the soon to be queen of Care Critter Kingdom. However, she slacks off, claiming that she won't get fired since she is the star mascot of the park. She doesn't even seem to bat an eye when a guy sees her changing. Brianna dreams of becoming a celebrity. She often gets into arguments with Caitlyn.
